title: fix(ui): pause hidden storage maintenance polling
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Storage settings keep polling maintenance progress every two seconds while the browser tab is hidden.

## User Impact

Hidden tabs pause automatic progress reads and refresh once on return. The Gateway maintenance batch continues normally.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace the page-owned raw interval with the existing visibility-aware poll helper. Preserve explicit refresh, status-error recovery, reconnects, and mutation admission.

## Evidence

- Added regressions for visible and hidden starts, no hidden status reads, and completion discovery on return.
- Local autoreview of the complete change against `82777f305ef8cf01d462998707291dd777f2f8a3`: no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- Targeted formatting and `git diff --check` pass.
- Production delta: -8 lines; tests: +20 lines. Removed the duplicate timer lifecycle.
- Native focused runtime proof: 14 tests pass across session-storage.test.tsx and session-storage-route.test.tsx.
- Baseline reproduction: Both visible-start and hidden-start regressions fail on the original producer: five extra status reads in ten hidden seconds. Restoring this head passes.
- Task-owned native workspace uses its own frozen dependencies; hosted CI owns broad validation.
